t: A ready-built robot rover for learning the Viam robotics software.
steps: Find a used Viam Rover 2, or build one from the open CAD and parts list on GitHub.
Get a Raspberry Pi 4, a microSD card, and four 18650 batteries with a charger.
Flash 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS with Raspberry Pi Imager and enable I2C.
Mount the Pi and connect the ribbon cable.
Set the low-voltage cutoff to match your battery pack.
Install viam-server and add the rover config fragment in the Viam app.
Drive the rover from the Control tab in the browser.
Try a short Python SDK example that moves the base.
